marc:datafield.marc:subfield: The film is about three of unemployed men who wants to find work to cope with life. After being driven from home (illegally erected on trees), they navigated and saved Puteri Bunian, Puteri Buluh Betung. The princess grants three rewards for them for saving her. Do get a flying mat that will take them wherever they want. Re also got a magic bin that is able to see any place, any event that happens at any time around the world. Mi also gets the wisdom (or harmonica) rhythm that will get the desired object after intending and blowing it. Their adventures were continued with the search of Puteri Negara Pasir Dua Butir who had been kidnapped.
